sections.title: Architecture & operating model
sections.response_text:
Architecture and operating model

Prepared by {auditor_name} ({company}) on {date}.

{system_enclave_name} - Generic (CMMC L2 / 171).

The assessed system follows the fixed AIC Offline PIM enclave model:

  • Control plane: sign-in, privileged access, inventory, Current State Compliance, Assessment Binder, disclosures, and Secure Share
  • Managed machines with agents where enrolled (agentless discovery where supported)
  • System Groups for compliance and binder sampling scope
  • Recorded Remote Access / Connect for assigned workstations

Organization fields (legal name, CAGE, system name, MSP) fill this instance. They do not redefine the control plane.

Typical deployments run in cloud infrastructure (AIC-operated or customer tenant). On-premises partner models may apply.

AIC usually does not keep standing login access to customer hosts. Day-to-day work uses product roles, justifications, and evidence citations.

Where to cite evidence

  • Systems / Endpoints inventory and enclave systems list
  • System Groups
  • Current State Compliance findings, Fix-It trail, and auditor-pack ZIP
  • Secure Share citations (titles and ids only - no CUI document bodies)
  • Remote Access / Connect session recordings
  • Crypto custody / runtime-status posture
  • Disclosures presets
  • Offline agent enrollment and elevation channel status where in scope

Lab SoftHSM, demo passwords, and seed fixtures are not a production authorization or Met claim.

Security design follows NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5. CMMC packaging does not lower that bar.

sections.response_text:
Plan of action and milestones

Risk-accepted items name an approving official, a compensating control, and a revisit date.

Acceptance does not remove residual risk tracking.

Items move to Remediation Attempted when Fix-It or manual work starts, and to Resolved only after a verified retest - never by narrative or playbook apply alone.

  1. Stand up and operate the fixed enclave model (network, System Groups, agents, crypto custody) per the MSP and IT admin SOPs.

  3. Maintain elevation and password-recovery evidence on managed identities only (lab BEAVIS2: liebsoft / lanicu only - never operator accounts such as phil).
